gold: Cutaneous Bacillus cereus infection with bacteremia

selector.rationale: Numerous gram-variable rods in the necrotic epidermis and dermis, consistent with Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and clinical presentation of vesicles with an erythematous base

rejected.label: Nectrotizing fasciitis
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence for necrotizing fasciitis, only one supporting note

rejected.label: Neutropenic sepsis
rejected.why: Neutropenic sepsis is a broader condition, Ecthyma gangrenosum better explains the specific skin lesions and gram stain results
